Package com.bupt.ta.service

Class FileStore

java.lang.Object
com.bupt.ta.service.FileStore
public class FileStore extends Object
Minimal JSON file persistence with no external libraries.

Supports reading and writing a JSON array of flat objects whose field values are strings. Expected on-disk format: [{"key":"value",...}, ...]. Missing files are treated as empty arrays. Also provides static helpers for serialising nested profile payloads and parsing JSON arrays used elsewhere (e.g. education history in ProfileService).

  • Method Details

    • readMaps

      public List<Map<String,String>> readMaps(String fileName) throws IOException
      Reads a JSON array file and returns a list of string-to-string maps.

      Returns an empty list when the file does not exist, is empty, or contains [].

      Parameters:
      fileName - file name relative to baseDir
      Returns:
      parsed rows; never null
      Throws:
      IOException - if the file exists but cannot be read

    • writeMaps

      public void writeMaps(String fileName, List<Map<String,String>> items) throws IOException
      Writes a list of string maps as a formatted JSON array to the given file.

      Parent directories are created if missing. Existing file content is replaced.

      Parameters:
      fileName - file name relative to baseDir
      items - rows to serialise; null entries are not expected
      Throws:
      IOException - if directories cannot be created or the file cannot be written

    • toJsonArrayOfObjects

      public static String toJsonArrayOfObjects(List<Map<String,String>> items)
      Serialises a JSON array of objects with string values.

      Used for nested profile payloads such as education history embedded in profile fields.

      Parameters:
      items - list of flat string maps, one per JSON object
      Returns:
      JSON array text with optional newlines between elements
